integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic, a medium shot frames a fit young woman in a bright, modern studio with warm natural light streaming from a large window, soft shadows on the floor and a shallow depth of field keeping her in crisp focus. She wears a fitted sports top and leggings, hair tied back, standing in a relaxed ready stance. She begins swaying her shoulders and hips to an internal beat, arms starting to flow. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed as her movements build into a coordinated full-body dance — smooth arm waves, hip sways, light footwork, and weight shifting side to side in clean rhythmic cycles. She adds a spin and a controlled bounce step, her expression confident and joyful, a subtle sheen of sweat on her skin, muscles defined in motion. In the final moments she settles into a still pose, chest rising with her breath, a satisfied smile as the movement resolves into stillness.

overall_soundscape: Soft footfalls and the light swish of athletic fabric move in steady rhythm with her dance, over a quiet room ambience with faint outdoor city hum beyond the window. Her breathing grows slightly fuller through the routine and settles as she holds the final pose.

non_diegetic_music: An upbeat, percussive electronic track at a moderate-fast tempo with a driving beat and warm synth layers, gradually easing in volume as her movement resolves into stillness.
